schema.heroes.<id>: same, with "levels" (e.g. "3-14") instead of req; cooldowns[name] = {level: cd} at each change; abilityLevel[name] = first level; levelText = the game text "<Hero> Level N Description"
schema.immune: damage immunities from DamageModel.immuneBloonProperties bit flags 1 lead 2 black 4 white 8 purple 16 frozen
schema.multipliers: RateSupportModel.multiplier multiplies the attack cooldown (0.85 = 15% shorter cooldown = 1/0.85 = 1.176x attacks); RangeSupportModel.multiplier is additive (+0.1 = +10% range); brew rateUp 0.1 = cooldown x0.9
schema.n: engine-ready reading of a buff (where the class is understood): stat (rate | range | pierce | damage | camo | damageType | brew | acid | discount | income | ...), cd = attack-cooldown multiplier, pct = +fraction, add = flat, mult = multiplier, dur = seconds the buff lasts, stacks = max stacks, perStack = value applies per stack. Brew: shots = attacks the buff lasts, rebuffBlock = seconds before a tower can be re-brewed; buffs[].every = seconds between throws. Acid: shotsPerDip, shotCap.
schema.radius: global if isGlobal or radius >= 9e5; else customRadius when isCustomRadius; else the owning (sub-)tower range when useTowerRange or nothing else; projectile-delivered buffs use the attack range
schema.range: towers.<id>.range = the tower range per crosspath (heroes: per level, at each change); radius "tower" means this range
schema.subLife: seconds the sub-tower carrying the buff lives (Sacrificial Totem 30 s, 60 s at L20)
schema.towers.<id>.abilities[]: name, cd (s), dur (longest lifespan among its behaviours, s), trigger (manual | passive | roundEnd | preLeak | livesLost | interval), unlock {path 0-2, tier 1-5} (from addedViaUpgrade, else req), fx (behaviours summarised), in (crosspaths "ABC" / hero levels), src (first file)
schema.towers.<id>.abilityUnlock: {ability name: [{path, tier}]} smallest crosspath requirement over every file that has it
schema.towers.<id>.buffs[]: t (model class), ctx (where it sits: ab:<ability>, atk:<attack>, sub:<sub-tower>), radius (units | "global"), every (s between throws when delivered by an attack), afterShots (Gwendolin-style "every Nth shot"), v (the model numbers; v.who = tower filter: sets/ids/area/notIds), req (smallest crosspath that has it), in, src

levelText.18: Slowing aura around Silas slows Bloons even more. Rimed Bloons take even more damage from Ice attacks, rime explosion damage increased even further.
levelText.19: Ice Walls have more pierce & lifespan. Ice Fragments pierce more and deal even more damage to frozen Bloons.
levelText.2: Ice Monkeys in radius create orbiting Ice Fragment projectiles when they attack.
levelText.20: Frozen Bloons take even more damage during Frostbite. Silas creates Ice Walls more often. Monkeys that freeze Bloons freeze them yet longer again.
levelText.3: Frostbite ability: Silas can hit all Bloons while active. When hitting frozen Bloons, target takes extra damage based on remaining freeze time.
levelText.4: Ice Walls form on the track near Silas. Ice Walls push back and freeze Bloons. MOABs are frozen for less time.
levelText.5: White Bloons are less resistant to Ice attacks. Monkeys that freeze Bloons freeze them for longer.
levelText.6: Silas can attack Bloons in the range of Ice Monkeys anywhere.
levelText.7: Frozen Cascade ability: Creates a shattering blast of ice around Silas then other Ice Monkeys and Coldchain Skywardens, spreading out from Silas. Frozen Bloons take extra damage from ability.
levelText.8: Buffs the ranges of all Ice Monkeys and Coldchain Skywardens, and grants more Hero XP for each Tier 3 Ice Monkey.
levelText.9: Frozen Bloons damaged during Frostbite take more damage. Ice Fragment damage & pierce increased.

levelText.1: Striker Jones shoots a powerful bazooka to explode the Bloons and push them back on hit.
levelText.10: Artillery Command: Resets cooldown on all Bomb Shooters and Mortar Monkeys.
levelText.12: Slightly increased attack range and pops 2 extra layers per shot.
levelText.14: Concussive Shell affects a larger area and for a longer duration.
levelText.15: Concussive Shell cooldown reduced to 11 seconds.
levelText.17: Increased range and pops 8 layers per shot.
levelText.18: All Bomb Shooters and Mortar Monkeys attack an additional 10% faster.
levelText.19: Increased attack speed and makes all Black Bloons vulnerable to explosive damage.
levelText.20: Artillery Command also gives double damage and pops per shot to all Bomb Shooters and Mortar Monkeys for 10 seconds.
levelText.3: Concussive Shell: Shoots a guided shell following target priority, stunning whatever Bloon it hits.
levelText.4: All Bomb Shooters and Mortar Monkeys on screen shoot 10% faster.
levelText.5: Makes all Black Bloons less resistant to explosive damage from all Monkeys.
levelText.6: Blast radius and pops for Jones' normal attacks increases greatly.
levelText.7: Pops 4 layers per shot and Mortar Monkeys blast radius increased by 10%. Target Focus: For 15 seconds Mortar Monkeys target touch/cursor with increased accuracy.
levelText.8: Towers near the hero get +5% range and +25% pierce.
levelText.9: Increased attack speed and increased Concussive Shell pierce, damage, and stun.

text.Absolute Zero Description: Each attack freezes all Bloons everywhere for a short time. Snowstorm freezes all Bloon types for even longer while greatly increasing attack speed of all Ice Monkeys for the duration.
text.Armor Piercing Shells Description: Shots can pop Black Bloons and do extra damage to Ceramic Bloons. Duration increases as Churchill levels.
text.Artillery Command Description: Resets cooldown on all Bomb Shooters and Mortar Monkeys.
text.Ball of Light Description: Brings forth a powerful ball of energy to strike down the Bloons.
text.Big Squeeze Description: Grabs a MOAB, BFB, DDT (if visible), or ZOMG and crushes it to bits over 5 seconds.
text.Biohack Description: 4 closest Monkeys pop an extra layer per attack for 6 seconds. Affected Monkeys can't attack for 2 seconds after effect ends.
text.Blade Maelstrom Description: Blade Maelstrom ability: Covers the area in a storm of blades.
text.Blast Chain Ability Description: Sea mines fire off quicker for a short time
text.Blood Sacrifice Description: Sacrifice a targeted Tower to grant Adora large amounts of XP and boost her attack range and rate of fire for a short time.
text.Bomb Blitz Description: Deals much more damage and gains the passive Bomb Storm Ability - when lives would be lost, the Bomb Storm automatically triggers, which destroys all but the biggest of Bloons.
text.Brambles Description: Creates a spiked bush on the track that can pop 50 Bloons.
text.Call to Arms Description: Call to Arms Ability: Gives all Monkeys +50% attack speed and pops for a short time.
text.Cocktail of Fire Description: Hurls a flask of flammable liquid, burning Bloons that pass through the fire.
text.Concussive Shell Description: Shoots a guided shell to the largest Bloon on screen, stunning it.
text.Dark Ritual Description: Harvests a huge number of Bloons near Corvus.
text.Drone Swarm Description: Etienne launches 4 more temporary drones to wreak some Bloon popping havoc.
text.Firestorm Description: Sets the whole screen alight, burning all Bloons and granting the Heat It Up buff to all Monkeys.
text.First Strike Capability Description: First Strike Ability: A devastating missile strike targeting the largest Bloon on screen, plus splash damage.
text.Frostbite Description: For a duration Silas can hit White Bloons & detonate any Freezes applied to the target dealing bonus damage based on the remaining freeze time.
text.Frozen Burial Description: Immediately freezes and damages all Bloons, dealing far more damage to any Bloons that were already Frozen before being hit by the ability, then fills the track with additional Ice Walls.
text.Frozen Cascade Description: When activated creates an icy explosion centered around each of the player’s Ice Monkeys one after the other in a chain reaction leading out from the Hero.
text.Glue Storm Description: Glue Storm Ability: Pelts the whole screen with glue for 20 seconds.
text.Glue Strike Description: Glue Strike Ability: Glues all Bloons on screen, removing Lead immunity, and causing them to take more damage from all sources while it lasts.
text.Ground Zero Description: Bomb damage increased significantly. Ground Zero Ability: Drops a huge bomb that destroys most things on screen.
text.Heartstopper Description: Allows Purple popping and prevents any Regrow from happening for 10 seconds.
text.Homeland Defense Description: Ability now increases attack speed and pops by 100% for all Monkeys for 20 seconds.
text.IMF loan Description: IMF Loan ability: Gives you $9,000 but you have to pay it back over time.
text.Jungle's Bounty Description: Vines create stronger thorn piles. Druid generates cash and lives at the end of each round, plus extra cash per Banana Farm near the Druid. Vine Crush Ability: Vines grab many Bloons at once, following Druid's target priority.
text.Leaping Sword Attack Description: Sauda's dramatic Lead popping leap attack slams down on her targeted Bloons.
text.Legend of the Night Description: We turn to him, when all hope is lost...
text.MOAB Barrage Description: Launches a barrage of shells at up to 10 MOAB-Class Bloons on screen, dealing massive damage each time.
text.MOAB Hex Description: Places a curse on a MOAB-Class Bloon, it takes damage every second until annihilated.
text.Mega Mine Description: Deploys a devastating Mega Mine that triggers on MOABs and stuns nearby Bloons.
text.Monkey-Nomics Description: For when you're too big to fail...
text.Naval Tactics Description: Greatly increases attack speed of nearby water-based Monkeys for a short time.
text.Overclock Description: Overclock Ability: Target another tower to supercharge its attack speed for a short time.
text.Perma Charge Description: Perma Charge has permanent super fast attack speed. Ability increases the lethality even more.
text.Plasma Monkey Fan Club Description: Elite membership of this club grants the Dart Monkeys even more power!
text.Psionic Scream Description: Psi unleashes a silent scream that throws the Bloons into utter chaos.
text.Psychic Blast Description: Psi unleashes a wave of power that stuns nearby Bloons for a long time.
text.Rallying Roar Description: All nearby Monkeys can pop +1 layer for a short time.
text.Rapid Shot Description: Triple attack speed for a short time.
text.Sacrificial Totem Description: A totem that gives Camo detection, extra pierce, attack range, attack speed, and projectile speed to nearby Monkeys, especially Wizard Monkeys. Drains 10 lives.
text.Snowstorm Description: Snowstorm Ability: Freezes all regular Bloons on screen, briefly freezes White, Zebra, and Camo, and slows MOAB-class.
text.Soul Harvest Description: Harvests a small number of Bloons near Corvus.
text.Special Poperations Description: Deploys a powerful special Monkey Marine with a machine gun.
text.Spike Storm Description: Spike Storm ability: Shoots out a thick layer of spikes over the entire track.
text.Spirit Walk Description: Corvus can shift to any valid location.
text.Storm of Arrows Description: Covers a large area in a deadly rain of arrows.
text.Super Maelstrom Description: Even more powerful Maelstrom ability and lasts longer.
text.Super Monkey Fan Club Description: Super Monkey Fan Club Ability: Converts up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys including itself into Super Monkeys for 15 seconds. Regular attack speed also increased.
text.Supply Drop Description: Supply Drop Ability: drops a crate full of cash. Activates Supply Drop for other Snipers. Regular attack also damages Lead Bloons and increases Shrapnel popping power.
text.Sword Charge Description: Sauda slides along the whole track, devastating Bloons as she goes.
text.Syphon Funding Description: Downgrades most newly spawned Bloons by 1 rank. Cash per pop from affected Bloons is double. Lasts 10 seconds.
text.Tech Terror Description: Annihilation ability: Destroys most Bloons completely and utterly within blast radius.
text.The Long Arm of Light Description: Greatly increases attack range and power for a short time & damages all Bloon Types.
text.Transforming Tonic Description: Transformation ability: Turns Alchemist into powerful attack Monster for 20 seconds.
text.Tsar Bomba Description: A very, very large bomb. Someone put a stop to this craziness!
text.Turbo Charge Description: Turbo Charge ability: Makes this Monkey attack incredibly fast for 10 seconds.
text.UCAV Description: High altitude surveillance drone becomes devastating combat drone for a short time.
text.Ultraboost Description: Ultra-Overclocked Monkeys gain a small but permanent boost every time they are overclocked.
text.Wall of Trees Description: Summons a wall of trees across the track that destroy all Bloons that enter. When full, the trees burst into money.
